name: Talus
description: Scree: triangles and diamonds of scattered size tumbling over a faintly ruled slope.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 50%; @size: calc(@rand(10px, 34px) * 6 / @size-col); -webkit-transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg)); transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(@pick(0deg, 45deg)); background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: @pick(polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%)); clip-path: @pick(polygon(50% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%), polygon(50% 0, 100% 50%, 50% 100%, 0 50%)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @random(0.45) { -webkit-box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); box-shadow: 0 -1px 0 @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
